title: ADA Title II & PDF/UA-1 Public Document Auditor Input
description: Provide one or more website URLs or direct PDF URLs to crawl and audit for ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA-1) and WCAG 2.1 AA conformance.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more website URLs (e.g. a city homepage, /DocumentCenter page, or board packet directory) or direct PDF URLs to audit.

maxPages.title: Max HTML Pages to Crawl
maxPages.description: Maximum number of same-domain HTML pages to crawl while discovering public PDF links.

maxPdfs.title: Max PDFs to Audit
maxPdfs.description: Maximum number of unique PDF documents to download and audit.

timeoutSecs.title: HTTP Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching web pages and PDF documents.
